title: Nager.Date public holidays API
summary: Public holidays for Italy (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code IT), returned as a JSON array with date, name in English and local language, and flags per holiday (global vs regional, types such as 'Public'). Data is available for all years at least back to 2003 (probed) and into the future. All Italian national public holidays are marked as 'global: true', meaning they apply nationwide. No regional/local holidays specific to Valdena municipality are present (counties field is always null for Italy). Serves as a supplementary dataset for interpreting low clinic-visit counts on holidays/weekends in the production window.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the holiday in YYYY-MM-DD format

fields.name: localName
fields.description: Holiday name in the local language (Italian)

fields.name: fixed
fields.description: Whether the holiday date is fixed on the calendar

fields.name: global
fields.description: Whether the holiday applies everywhere in the country

fields.name: counties
fields.description: List of counties if regional; null for national holidays

fields.name: launchYear
fields.description: First year the holiday was observed; null if not specified

spatial.notes: Returns data for any country code. For Italy, all returned holidays have global=true, meaning national holidays. No Valdena-specific local holidays are represented.

quality_notes: Does not include local/regional holidays specific to Valdena municipality (counties field is always null for Italy probes). Only national IT holidays are provided.
Supplementary source: helps identify public holidays to interpret zero/low clinic visit counts on those days but does not directly provide clinic data.

Fixity: Easter Sunday (Pasqua) is correctly a movable holiday (fixed: false). All other Italian holidays are fixed: false too — this appears to be a schema characteristic where fixed indicates whether the date calculation is algorithm-based, not whether it's on the same date each year.
